stem: A healthcare technology company processes insurance claims through an API backed by generative AI. As part of modernizing this pipeline, the company wants to roll out new Amazon Bedrock model versions gradually rather than switching over all at once. Traffic sent to a newly released model version should keep climbing as long as things look healthy, and should pull back the moment performance dips below what’s acceptable. Wire up an Amazon EventBridge rule so that whenever a new model version ships, it kicks off an AWS Step Functions workflow. Have the workflow branch to send more traffic when metrics look good, or roll traffic back automatically when they fall short.
